---
title: "The project language overrides the per-language file next to the project"
toc: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<h2 id="toc-title">Contents from the project</h2>']
        - ['Sommaire du fichier de langue', 'Contents from the language file']
---

## Section

The project sets `lang: fr` and `toc-title-document` under `language`.
The project directory also has `_language.yml` and `_language-fr.yml` files.
The value in `_quarto.yml` must replace the value of the French language file.
